map.为何用生存概率求和而非直接查平均余命？: Why sum survival probabilities instead of reading mean remaining life directly?
map.做人口或 pension 精算的寿命假设校验。: Life assumption checks for population or pension actuarial work.
map.完全期望和取整期望区别？: Difference between complete expectation and rounded expectation?
map.完全期望寿命把当年内存活片段也计入（连续化），比离散取整期望长约 0.5 岁；精: The complete expectation of life also counts the surviving fraction within the current year (continuous form), so it runs about 0.5 year longer than the discrete rounded expectation; actuarial reserves and annuity pricing need the complete expectation for accuracy.
map.完整 eₓ 直接对 ₜpₓ 加权求和；常用取整期望 eₓ° = Σₜ₌₁^ω ₜ: The complete eₓ is a weighted sum of ₜpₓ; the common rounded expectation eₓ° = Σₜ₌₁^ω ₜpₓ ≈ eₓ − 0.5.
map.由一组逐年生存概率 ₜpₓ 求完全期望寿命 eₓ。: Complete expectation of life eₓ from a sequence of annual survival probabilities ₜpₓ.
map.由逐年生存概率序列求完全期望寿命 使用指南: Complete expectation of life from annual survival probability sequence user guide
map.输入从当前年龄起各年的生存概率序列（逗号或空格分隔），累加求完全期望寿命 e_x: Enter the survival probability for each year from the current age (comma or space separated) and sum them to get the complete expectation of life e_x, for estimating expected remaining life in demography, pension and life actuarial work.
map.输入逐年生存概率序列（逗号或空格分隔），求期望余命。: Enter the annual survival probability sequence (comma or space separated) to get the expected remaining life.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above.
